hero.title: Auto Reply That Answers the Question, Not Just "We'll Get Back to You"
hero.subtitle: Replace canned greeting messages with an AI that reads each WhatsApp chat, understands what the customer actually wants, and answers it instantly, 24/7, in their own language, capturing every lead along the way

definition: WhatsApp Auto Reply is a Cekat.AI feature that answers incoming WhatsApp messages automatically with a humanlike AI agent, understanding the customer's intent and replying with a real answer 24/7, instead of sending a fixed greeting or away message.

benefits.title: Answer the Actual Question, Not With a Canned Greeting
benefits.body: "Thanks for your message, we'll reply soon" doesn't sell anything. Cekat.AI's humanlike agent reads what the customer is really asking, price, stock, how to order, and replies with a real answer in seconds. It understands intent and context, not keywords, so it responds like a trained CS admin, not an autoresponder.

benefits.title: Never Miss a Lead Because It Came In at Midnight
benefits.body: Most leads message after hours, and a reply that lands the next morning is often a sale lost to whoever answered first. With AI working hours, your team handles chats while online and the AI takes over nights and weekends automatically, so every WhatsApp message gets an instant answer, whatever time it arrives.

benefits.title: Every Auto Reply Becomes a Lead in Your CRM
benefits.body: An answered question is only worth something if you can follow up. Cekat.AI captures every WhatsApp conversation into the CRM automatically, no manual input, building a living customer record and moving each contact through Visitor, Lead, and Buyer stages with suggested next steps for your team.

benefits.body: You don't script hundreds of keyword rules. Paste your SOPs and business info into the knowledge base and the AI is ready to answer real questions, building it is about as easy as briefing a new CS admin. Need branching logic? Use the visual drag-and-drop flow designer, still with zero code.

faq.a: WhatsApp auto reply is an automatic response sent when a customer messages your business. With Cekat.AI, it's not a fixed greeting, a humanlike AI agent reads the question, understands the intent, and replies with a real answer 24/7 through the official WhatsApp Business API.

faq.q: How is this different from the auto reply in WhatsApp Business?
faq.a: The free WhatsApp Business app only sends fixed greeting and away messages, the same text no matter what the customer asks. Cekat.AI actually answers the question: it reads intent, pulls from your knowledge base, replies in the customer's language, and captures the conversation as a lead in the CRM.

faq.q: Does the auto reply work 24/7, even at night?
faq.a: Yes, that's the point. The AI agent answers around the clock, so a lead messaging at midnight gets the same instant reply as one at noon. With AI working hours, your team covers chats while online and the AI takes over nights and weekends automatically.

faq.q: Can the AI really answer questions about my business?
faq.a: Yes. The agent works from a knowledge base you build with your own SOPs, prices, and product details, and it understands intent and context rather than matching keywords. Anything it shouldn't handle is escalated to your team with the full chat history attached.

faq.q: Do I need to write keyword rules for every question?
faq.a: No. You don't script keyword-by-keyword replies. You paste your business information into the knowledge base and the AI answers naturally, Cekat.AI describes it as about as easy as briefing a new CS admin, with most teams live in around 5 minutes.

faq.q: What happens when a customer needs a human?
faq.a: The conversation is handed to your team with the complete chat history attached, so the customer never repeats themselves. With AI working hours, this runs on a schedule: the AI covers after-hours messages and your team takes over automatically when they come online.

faq.q: Is auto reply through Cekat.AI safe for my WhatsApp number?
faq.a: Yes. Cekat.AI is an official Meta Business Partner and runs auto replies through the official WhatsApp Business API, the compliant way to message customers at scale, unlike unofficial bots that put your number at risk.

faq.q: Does it capture leads or just answer questions?
faq.a: Both. Every WhatsApp conversation is captured into the CRM automatically with no manual input, contact details, chat history, and behavior in one record. Customer Stages track each contact from Visitor to Lead to Buyer, so answers turn into follow-ups and sales.

faq.q: Can it reply in more than one language?
faq.a: Yes. The AI agent is multilingual and replies in the language the customer writes in. Minori Group, serving Japan and Indonesia, handles 100% of inquiries with multilingual AI on Cekat.AI, two languages and two timezones on one platform.
